summary.text: Roof Tile Breaker is an immortal killer move named when Fang Gong slams his palms on Winding Light Platform.

claims.text: Fang Gong appears above Wan clan’s first supreme elder as rank eight aura surges. Wan clan’s first supreme elder keeps his sight on Fang clan’s earth path Immortal Gu House and stays confident in Winding Light Platform’s protection. Fang Gong activates the killer move and slams down with his palms. Ripples spread around Winding Light Platform as it blocks the attack. He slams without stopping. Palm shadows fly as attacks rain down. Winding Light Platform at rank seven possesses rank eight battle strength and blocks the attacks. Wan clan’s first supreme elder then finds that every attack holds a strange power. The outer defensive methods hold, but the power infiltrates the house and causes severe damage to its Gu worms. Almost in an instant, Winding Light Platform is damaged to a great extent. The yellow beams that had been restricting Fang clan’s earth path Immortal Gu House lose their source of power and disperse. Wan clan’s first supreme elder controls Winding Light Platform to retreat. Fang Gong holds the house down while Chicken Dog Coop also attacks. After enduring for a while, Winding Light Platform crumbles apart.
Fang clan paid a lot of resource points to advance the rank of the core Immortal Gu of roof tile breaker and exchanged for many Immortal Gu to construct that earth path Immortal Gu House.
Fang clan possessed roof tile breaker, a killer move that could restrain Immortal Gu Houses, similar to Zuo Qiu’s state of disunity.

Fang Gong gives control of Inquiry Dock to other Fang clan Gu Immortals and flies out. He collides with Myriad Age Building and the whole building almost collapses. He activates roof tile breaker. Palm shadows fly. Myriad Age Building’s defensive killer moves cannot block roof tile breaker, and the house starts to crumble rapidly. The house is forced to activate its strongest defensive method, which rapidly extracts Fang Gong’s lifespan. He retreats after forcing that method out. He then charges Red River Wheel. Roof tile breaker activates again. Red River Wheel retreats rapidly while burning flames close in on Fang Gong. He does not dodge and sticks to Red River Wheel amidst the flames.

Fang Yuan thinks that for Gu Immortal experts, once the mechanics of the Immortal Gu House were deciphered, they would be easy to target and deal with. Be it Fang clan’s roof tile breaker or Zuo Qiu clan’s state of disunity, they were counters to Immortal Gu Houses.
